heading_en: Exposures Guaranteed by the Regional Economy Vitalization Corporation of Japan and the Great East Japan Earthquake Business Rehabilitation Support Corporation
summary_ja: 地域経済活性化支援機構及び東日本大震災事業者再生支援機構の保証付きエクスポージャーを十パーセントとし、第百条・第百五条を適用しない。
summary_en: Exposures guaranteed by REVIC and the Great East Japan Earthquake Business Rehabilitation Support Corporation take 10%; Articles 100 and 105 do not apply.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 22 through the preceding Article, the risk weight of exposures guaranteed by the Regional Economy Vitalization Corporation of Japan (meaning the Regional Economy Vitalization Corporation of Japan provided in the Act on the Regional Economy Vitalization Corporation of Japan (Act No. 63 of 2009)) and the Great East Japan Earthquake Business Rehabilitation Support Corporation shall be 10%.
The provisions of Article 100 and Article 105 shall not apply to the guarantees provided in the preceding paragraph.
